items.text: Free morning at Hanastay Aya: pack, last breakfast nearby. Self check-out by 11:00. Closed on Sun: O16 Usami-tei and O17 Yoshino Sushi.
Only if not done on Fri 20: leave with the bags, lockers at Shin-Osaka (~11:30, sizes not verified), JR to Osaka (~4 min). Sunday cafés open ~11:00. Back at Shin-Osaka by 13:30.
Option, if the suitcases come with us: Crosta Shin-Osaka (9:00–20:00, ¥1,000 per bag, book online) for the optional morning; lockers uncertain.
If no optional morning: Yotsubashi Line Tamade → Daikokuchō, change to the Midōsuji Line → Shin-Osaka (Jorudan 12:03 → 12:32).
Shin-Osaka: ekiben and drinks; 551 Hōrai buns are sold in the station (9:00–21:30).
Through the gate with the smartEX QR tickets; find the platform for Nozomi 416, car 14.
Nozomi 416 Shin-Osaka → Shinagawa, car 14, seats 17-D and 17-E (Fuji on the right, ~2 h in).
At Shinagawa walk to the Keikyū platforms.
Keikyū Rapid-Limited Express Shinagawa → Keikyū-Kamata (Jorudan). If missed: JR 16:57 → 17:22, ¥440.
Keikyū Airport Line Keikyū-Kamata → Ōtorii, then 9 min walk to Kc-III.
Self check-in at Kc-III (16:00–22:00 only). Quiet hours 21:00–8:00.
Nihao annex, 3 min from the east exit (17:00–22:00). Kangei is the other classic.
Back to Ōtorii and Kc-III before 21:00.
Reminders: if the suitcases were sent ahead, they are on the way to Haneda and we have overnight bags only. Confirm the TK8364 terminal (checked Sat 21, probably T2).
